title: Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tenure Credit on TRAC Deficiencies, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Relationship Program Bulletin — Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tenure and the TRAC Deficiency

**Rule.** For the deficiency billed on a TRAC unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease whose sale settlement falls short of its book value, the deficiency relationship-tenure credit is $100 where the business has a Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract, open or closed, funded 36 or more whole months before today, $50 where its earliest-funded balloon contract was funded 12 to 35 whole months before today, and nothing where it has no balloon contract funded at least 12 whole months before today.

**Records read.** The funding entries posted on the business's Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contracts, open or closed, and their dates. Whole months run from the funding date to today and are one fewer where today's day of the month is smaller than the funding date's; a funding falls within the last N whole months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today.

| Earliest balloon funding, whole months before today | Relationship-tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | $100 |
| 12 to 35 | $50 |
| fewer than 12, or no balloon contract funded | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A balloon contract funded 48 whole months ago and paid in full since: $100; a closed contract counts.
2. The business's only balloon contract was funded 35 whole months ago: $50. At 36 whole months: $100.
3. Its only balloon contract was funded 11 whole months ago: nothing. At 12 whole months: $50.
4. Funded on the 20th of a month, today being the 19th of the month 36 months later: 35 whole months, $50.
